title: Squoosh Bench: Evaluating UX-1 on 318 Historical Website A/B Tests
author: Rohith Pasula, Johari Dramiga, Viraj Shah, Suzan Halim et al.
description: Experimentation teams must decide which proposed website changes to test with live traffic. We evaluated whether forecasts from simulated shoppers could inform that choice. summary: Experimentation teams must decide which proposed website changes to test with live traffic. We evaluated whether forecasts from simulated shoppers could inform that choice.
takeaways: Squoosh UX-1, a model fine-tuned on human browsing data, simulated 1,000 shoppers per arm and correctly classified 267 of 318 outcomes (84.0%, 95% Wilson interval 79.5-87.6%, treating experiments as independent).
We evaluated whether forecasts from simulated shoppers could inform that choice.
We screened 412 historical website A/B tests and evaluated four systems on the 318 that ran longer than 21 days.
